# Velocità

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Brazilian running specialist with three physical stores in Sao Paulo (Jardins, Moema, Pinheiros) and an online store. Sells running shoes, apparel, accessories, watches and GPS devices and nutrition products from brands such as Asics, Brooks, Hoka, Nike and Garmin. Its about page says the online store delivers to customers across the country.

*ES:* Especialista brasileño en running con tres tiendas físicas en São Paulo (Jardins, Moema, Pinheiros) y una tienda online. Vende zapatillas de running, indumentaria, accesorios, relojes y GPS, y productos de nutrición de marcas como Asics, Brooks, Hoka, Nike y Garmin. Su página institucional indica que la tienda online entrega a clientes de todo el país.
